rows.text: zeroes qwords `[rcx]` and `[rcx+8]`, stores `rdx` at qword `rcx+0x10` and returns `rcx`

stores the address `00D80970` at qword `[rcx]`; points qwords `+8`, `+0x10` and `+0x18` at `rcx+8` and zeroes dword `+0x20` and qword `+0x28`; stores `rdx` at qword `+0x30`, `r8d` and `r9d` at dwords `+0x38`/`+0x3c`, and the fifth and sixth (stack) arguments at qwords `+0x40`/`+0x48`; links the two-qword node at `rcx+0x50` in front of the list headed by qword `01F2EBB8` (node `+0` = the old head, node `+8` = `01F2EBB8`, then qword `01F2EBB8` and the old head's qword `+8` = the node); returns `rcx`

returns 5 when `r8d` is negative (signed); otherwise takes `old` = qword `[rcx+8]` when dword `[rcx]` with bit 31 cleared is above 1, `rcx+8` when it is 1 and null when it is 0; when `r8d` is 1 it copies dword `[rdx]` to dword `rcx+8` and takes `rcx+8` as the new pointer and 1 as the new header, otherwise `rdx` and `r8d` with bit 31 set; calls `006C7D00` + 0x8C(`old`) when `old` is non-null, differs from both the new pointer and `rcx+8`, and bit 31 of dword `[rcx]` is clear; stores the new pointer at qword `rcx+8` unless it is `rcx+8`, stores the new header at dword `[rcx]` and returns 0

notes: 006B6820: 00D80970 is a lea target stored at [rcx] (likely a vtable); the listing does not decode it. The 01F2EBB8 load is annotated with its static value 0x01F2EBB8 (an empty self-linked head); the row states the run-time link order. 006C7D00: the null test on rcx+8 at 006C7D5D cannot fail in practice and is not stated.
